description: Lightning F.53K 53-422, code K; first flight 18 Aug 1969, delivered Dec 1969. Mounted on two poles in a take-off attitude in front of the base headquarters at Ali Al Salem, recently repainted (Thunder & Lightnings, photos Nov 2008 and 2016, page current 28 Nov 2021; Flickr 2016 'Preserved with Base Headquarters'; Scramble 'preserved in front of headquarters').

Lightning F.53K 53-423, first flight 11 Sep 1969, delivered Dec 1969. Gate guard at Ali Al Salem, on blocks with gear down, in poor condition (mangled jet pipe, punctured skin, flat tyres) and repainted with the false serial 53-421 (Thunder & Lightnings, photos Nov 2008 and 2016; AirHistory.net photo Oct 2016 captioned 'this is serial 53-423/G, preserved on base'; Flickr 2016 'Gate-Guard, Ali Al Salem'). Wreckage of T.55K 55-410 also lies at Ali Al Salem as a fire-training airframe and is not recorded as a display.

Mirage F1CK-2 727, preserved at the Air Force Academy within Ali Al Salem Air Base (Flickr 'Aircraft throughout the years', 2016). Mirage F1CKs 710 and 711 are dumped at Ali Al Salem (711 damaged by indirect fire in 1991) and are not recorded as displays.
